_doc: Blind OOS 2017-2019 collection. CRITICAL: Verity filed Chapter 11 on August 31, 2018 — DURING the OOS window. This is the deep-distress anchor.

moodys.notes: Caa2 carry-forward; specific 2016 Moody's release not directly extracted.

rating_actions_in_window.action: Affirmed CCC on $273M of Series 2005A/F/G/H fixed-rate bonds; revised outlook to POSITIVE from stable.
Affirmed CCC on outstanding debt; revised outlook BACK to stable from positive.

DEFAULT/CHAPTER 11 FILING. 17 Debtors filed voluntary petitions Aug 31, 2018 in U.S. Bankruptcy Court Central District of California (Los Angeles Division), Case No. 18-20151, Judge Ernest M. Robles. DIP financing up to $185M secured. Cited >$1B aggregate bond debt + unfunded pension liabilities, inability to renegotiate burdensome contracts, seismic capex obligations.
DOWNGRADE CCC -> CC post-Ch 11 filing; negative outlook; affected ~$325M of debt.
